title: American's XLR Seats Keep Breaking, Delta Quietly Cuts 21 Cities, and Qatar Backs Off Its Avios Crackdown
summary: American's shiny new A321XLRs have a business class problem — the seats keep getting stuck. Plus, Delta's been trimming long-haul cities you probably didn't notice, Breeze pilots call in a federal mediator, and Qatar Airways quietly walks back one of the more annoying loyalty changes we've covered this year.
